text:
Anna: FYI OrbisQ just opened a new project "search-microservices" and we saw a sudden embeddings ingest spike ~3x overnight. They pasted a note about v2 personalization. @Diego can you check if hosted pool can sustain? :eyes:
Diego: On it. Which org/project tag?
Anna: org:orbisq, project:search-microservices. PM says hourly batches to keep recs near-real-time.
Cleo: Got a message from their PM: "We9re rolling personal recs v2, need near-RT embeddings for ~50k items/day, initial bursts ~8k/hr when indexing." Copying verbatim.
Mira: 50k/day is within hosted capacity in steady state, bursts could push latency. Do they expect SLAs or is best-effort acceptable?
Anna: They asked for a <48h onboarding timeline and low tail latency. Also renewal in ~2 quarters; they tied conversion targets to this feature.
Diego: Running a quick probe now against hosted-pool-3.
capacity-bot: auto-allocated +2 concurrent workers to hosted-pool-3 for org:orbisq (policy: short-burst).
Sam: We should propose a short reserved pod as a stopgap (7-14 days) while we scope a Dedicated pilot for multi-team scale. I'll sketch cost + runbook.
Mira: Also need an enablement packet: onboarding checklist, tokenization guidance (they reported mixed HTML/docx producing inflated token counts), and recommended batch/concurrency settings. Quick suggestion:
```json
{"batch_size":256, "concurrency":4, "prefix_cache":true}
```
Diego: Ran perf check under current burst: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms. With +2 workers p95 drops ~220ms. These are rough numbers.
Anna: Action items: @Sam draft proposal & pricing; @Diego run a sustained perf test and capture p50/p95 at 1h/3h; @Mira prepare onboarding checklist and tokenization tips; @Cleo sync with customer tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Cleo: Confirmed 11:00 PT with OrbisQ. Also they reported some documents producing long tokenized lengths due to injected HTML blocks.
Sam: I'll include a 3-month usage projection assuming 3 teams onboard and a growth scenario. Recommend route: short reserved pilot -> Dedicated pilot -> reserved capacity commit.
Anna: This is a clear expansion signal and should be flagged for CS leadership review (renewal-opportunity). Moving to CS weekly on Monday. :calendar:
Mira: Also suggest adding a prompt set eval to detect quality regressions when we change batching/quantization.
Diego: Agree. Will attach perf logs to the ticket after sustained run.
Anna: Thanks team. Follow up after the sync. :thumbsup:
